newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM BEGINS FIM 110 MLN PLANT REBUILD.
newsitem.headline: UPM BEGINS FIM 110 MLN PLANT REBUILD.

text.p: Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said on Wednesday it had begun an earlier announced 110 million markka renovation of a magazine paper machine at its Kaipola mill.
"The cost estimate of the investment is 110 million," UPM-Kymmene said in a statement.
The renovation of the LWC (light-weight coated paper) machine will raise annual capacity by 15,000 tonnes to 255,000 tonnes, a UPM spokeswoman said.
The work would take less than three weeks, and the restart was scheduled for February 18, UPM said.
